summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.12/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.12 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 19, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 6¢ higher than a week ago, 25¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.57 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.88) and the highest in Superior ($4.35).
